entities.name: Giada
entities.description: Teenaged girl and youngest angel on New Capenna, revealed as The Font, a new source of Halo.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Plane of the angels and crime families.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: Crime family that kept Giada secret.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker Giada sacrificed herself to save.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who traveled with Elspeth and Giada.

entities.name: Adversary
entities.description: Agents of the Adversary tried to capture Giada.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: District with a cathedral and skyscrapers, toppled in the plan against Atraxa.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor whose forces threatened New Capenna.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: Street artist entrusted with placing the charges.

entities.name: Cabaretti Crescendo
entities.description: Event where Giada was revealed as The Font.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Giada was revived.

events.summary: Discovered by Cabaretti scouts, Giada is found able to turn sewage into pure Halo and the Cabaretti keep her secret.
events.quote: she could turn even the foulest city sewage into pure Halo

events.summary: During the Crescendo Elspeth rescues Giada from agents of the Adversary.
events.quote: she was rescued from agents of the Adversary by Elspeth Tirel

events.summary: In a Park Heights cathedral Giada sacrifices herself, becoming Halo that reinvigorates Elspeth and gives her Luxior to defeat Nixilis.
events.quote: she sacrificed herself to save her new friends

events.summary: Giada's actions make it possible for the other angels to return.
events.quote: Her actions made it possible for the other angels to return to New Capenna.

events.summary: Giada, restored with Halo, secretly shields Errant as she topples Park Heights and ensures an angel rescues her.
events.quote: Giada was there with her every step of the way

events.summary: After Atraxa's death Giada leaves Capenna to help other planes alongside her fellow angels.
events.quote: Giada left Capenna to help the denizens of other planes

relations.quote: transforming into the magic of Halo and reinvigorating Elspeth
Though she never made her presence known to Errant
